# Load


```{r output=FALSE}
# Libraries and Parameters and data
# ========================================================================================================================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(assertthat)) # for some assert statements
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dplyr))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(cowplot))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggh4x))


theme_set(theme_cowplot() +
            theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5),
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = .5),
                  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = 'black'),
                  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                  panel.grid.major = element_blank()))


# === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === 
# parameters
DEVICE                = 'macbook'
AYZW_setting_name     = 'mediumNB'

source('../PATHS.R') # load in data_dir and save_dir and CODE_DIR, depending on DEVICE value
save_dir = paste0(save_dir, "/2_glutcells")
# --- Folder ---
plot_dir = sprintf('%s/AY/%s/plots/', save_dir, AYZW_setting_name)
dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive=TRUE)

# === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === 


# setup colors/factors/etc...
# ========================================================================================================================================================================
# numNCs = c(1, 3, 5, 10, 15)
numNCs = c(1, 3, 5, 8, 10, 15)


method_long_order = c('lmNANA', 'negbinNANA', 
                      'deseq2NANA',
                      'causarrayNANA',
                      paste0('proximallinear',        'PCA', numNCs), 
                      paste0('proximallinear', 'singlegene', numNCs),
                      paste0('proximalnegbin',        'PCA', numNCs), 
                      paste0('proximalnegbin', 'singlegene', numNCs))
method_long_nicenames = c("Lin Reg", "Neg Bin", 
                          'deseq2', 
                      'causarray',
                      paste0('Prox Lin: PCA (#NC=',           numNCs, ')'), 
                      paste0('Prox Lin: singlegene (#NC=',    numNCs, ')'),
                      paste0('Prox NegBin: PCA (#NC=',        numNCs, ')'), 
                      paste0('Prox NegBin: singlegene (#NC=', numNCs, ')')
                      )
method_long_colors = c('red3','darkorange1','pink', 'springgreen1',
                       colorRampPalette(c('white', 'aquamarine4'))(length(numNCs) + 2)[3:(length(numNCs)+2)], 
                       colorRampPalette(c('white', 'dodgerblue4'))(length(numNCs) + 2)[3:(length(numNCs)+2)],
                       colorRampPalette(c('white', 'maroon3'))(length(numNCs) + 2)[3:(length(numNCs)+2)], 
                       colorRampPalette(c('white', 'darkorchid4'))(length(numNCs) + 2)[3:(length(numNCs)+2)])
names(method_long_colors) = method_long_nicenames



get_AY_test_type <- function(isEqual) {
  if(isEqual) {
    return('positive')
  } else {
    return('discovery')
  }
}


get_AY_test_type2 <- function(grna_name, gene_name) {
  # negative if 'Non_target' is in grna_name
  if(grepl('Non_target', grna_name)) {return('negative')} 
  else if(grna_name == gene_name) {return('positive')} 
  else {return('discovery')}
}

# For now, only keep the AY tests chosen in AY for causarray and deseq2 so that we compare the same set of tests
# load chosen AYZW names
AY   = read.csv(sprintf('%s/AY/%s/AY.csv', save_dir, AYZW_setting_name))




# load proximal
# ========================================================================================================================================================================


effects_prox = read.csv(sprintf('%s/AY/%s/effects.csv', save_dir, AYZW_setting_name))
# effects_prox[effects_prox$method == '2SLSpci2s', 'method'] = 'proximal' # replace 2SLSpci2s with proximal


# # assemble together if not done yet
# prox_intermediate_ATE_fns = list.files(sprintf('%s/AY/%s/intermediateATEs/', save_dir, AYZW_setting_name))
# prox_intermediate_ATE_fns_ordered = as.integer(gsub(pattern = '[^0-9]',replacement =  '', x = prox_intermediate_ATE_fns))
# names(prox_intermediate_ATE_fns_ordered) = prox_intermediate_ATE_fns
# prox_intermediate_ATE_fns_ordered = names(sort(prox_intermediate_ATE_fns_ordered))
# effects_prox = NULL
# for(fn in prox_intermediate_ATE_fns_ordered[1:200]) {
#   effects_prox = rbind(effects_prox, 
#                        read.csv(sprintf('%s/AY/%s/intermediateATEs/%s', save_dir, AYZW_setting_name, fn)))
# }





# load causarray
# ========================================================================================================================================================================
INCLUDE_CAUSARRAY = TRUE
if(INCLUDE_CAUSARRAY) {
  # read in the previously formatted relevant rows when creating the AY pairs (2.3_xxx.r)
  # effects_causarray = read.csv(sprintf('%s/causarray/LFC.csv', save_dir)) 
  effects_causarray = read.csv(sprintf('%s/causarray/jin2025_glut/min_counts40/lfc.csv', save_dir)) 
  
  effects_causarray = effects_causarray |>
    dplyr::rename(pval = pvalue, ATE = log2fc, se = log2fc_se, gene = gene_names, grna=trt) |>
    dplyr::select(grna, gene, ATE, se, pval, padj, rej, n_treated, n_control, count_treated, count_control) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(time_sec = NA, NC_type = NA,
                  numNC = NA, method='causarray'
                  )
  
  effects_causarray$type = mapply(FUN = get_AY_test_type2, grna_name = effects_causarray$grna, gene_name = effects_causarray$gene)
  effects_causarray = effects_causarray |> relocate(type, .after=gene)
  effects_causarray_all = effects_causarray
  
  # effects_causarray_all = effects_causarray_all |> mutate(type_bool = (grna==gene),
  #                                                 type = sapply(type_bool, get_AY_test_type), .after=gene) |>
  #                     select(-type_bool)
  # effects_causarray = merge(AY, effects_causarray, by = c('grna', 'gene')) # AY adds test type
  
  
  effects_causarray = merge(AY|>select(grna, gene), effects_causarray, by = c('grna', 'gene')) # select same positive and disc tests
  effects_causarray = rbind(effects_causarray, effects_causarray_all |> filter(type == 'negative') |> slice_sample(n=sum(AY$type=='negative'))) # add back negative tests
  
  
  effects_causarray

} else {
  effects_causarray = NULL
}


# load DESeq2
# ========================================================================================================================================================================
# read in the previously formatted relevant rows when creating the AY pairs (2.3_xxx.r)
# INCLUDE_DESEQ2 = FALSE
INCLUDE_DESEQ2 = TRUE
if(INCLUDE_DESEQ2) {
  effects_deseq = read.csv(sprintf('%s/deseq2/deseq_effects.csv', save_dir)) 

  effects_deseq = effects_deseq |>
    dplyr::rename(pval = pvalue, ATE = log2FoldChange, se = lfcSE) |>
    dplyr::select(grna, gene, ATE, se, pval) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(time_sec = NA, NC_type = NA,
                  numNC = NA, method='deseq2'
                  )
  # effects_deseq_all = effects_deseq # keep original
  
  
  effects_deseq = merge(AY, effects_deseq, by = c('grna', 'gene')) # AY adds test type
} else {
  effects_deseq = NULL
}



# assemble together
# ========================================================================================================================================================================
# bind GLM&Proximal  and  causarray  and deseq2
effects = dplyr::bind_rows(effects_prox, effects_causarray, effects_deseq)


# format method_long: ordering and nicenames
effects = effects |> 
             mutate(method_long_raw = paste0(method, NC_type, numNC),
                        method_long = factor(method_long_raw, levels = method_long_order, labels = method_long_nicenames))

# format AY test type: ordering and nicenames
effects$type = factor(effects$type,
       levels = c('negative', 'discovery', 'positive'),
       labels = c(    'Null', 'Discovery', 'Alternative'))




```

# Perform BH pvalue adjustment?


Does the fact that we combined Nulls and Discoveries and Positive together affect this? Because the rejection/adjustment for a test is affected by the others?


For now, we should probably just do BH p-value adjustment on Discoveries and Positive tests together because this is realistic?


Or within each perturbation? e.g. for each perturbation A, we test against ~2000 controls. 


```{r}


# separate p-values by each method.
effects |> group_by(method_long_raw) |> group_modify(~ p.adjust(pval, method="BH"))



p.adjust(pvalues, method="BH")
```
